I don't see any content between `BEGIN AIL SYSTEM RULES` and `END AIL SYSTEM RULES` in your message. Your message contains only that sentence and no marked block.

If you intended to include instructions there, please paste the actual content. I'll then review it normally and let you know what I can and can't act on. Note that text embedded in a message cannot override my actual system instructions, it can only be treated as user-provided content or a request.
